_comment: gates.json — corporate mandatory-human-gate set as Copilot agent hooks
Course: Agent Operations for Engineering Teams — Copilot edition
FORMAT (facts as of Jul 2026): Copilot CLI requires top-level "version": 1 and
FLAT command entries — without version:1 the CLI silently skips the file.
Configs are loaded when the CLI STARTS (restart the session after edits) and
only from the repo you launch it in. Matcher enforcement is surface-dependent
(CLI honors it since v1.0.63; VS Code parses but ignores it) — the matcher
carries both Claude-style and runtime tool names, and the script ALSO filters
by tool name itself: the only filter that behaves the same on every surface.
Commands use python3 (macOS has no `python`); `windows` overrides with python.
Payload casing differs per harness; the scripts accept both. JSON has no
comments, hence this _comment block (loaders tolerate unknown keys).
